## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Singleton conformal set supports Benign [F1], though severity-3 stain degradation and 99% margin scores warrant attention.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, InSitu 3%, Normal 1%, Invasive 0% | Strong Benign score; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 86th percentile OOD (12/12 regions) [F6] | Pass, despite severity-3 stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent backbones share top class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign, 1 InSitu (87%), 2 Normal [F5] | Weak neighbor consensus; InSitu contrast |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Largest benign push (-1.27) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 8) · context · Below-typical score (0.15, contribution +0.38) [F3]; 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.52) reduces risk (-0.38) [F4]; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.24) slightly raises risk (+0.31); 12/20 spot check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Mild positive score (0.74, contribution +0.16); 19/20 spot check · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score more than random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0) and leans on Unreliable `normal_lobules` and `mitoses` (0/20 spot checks).

## Could be wrong if
- In situ carcinoma mimics benign lobules here, like 87%-similar InSitu case BACH_0043 (differing in pleomorphism and benign stroma/fat).
- Severity-3 stain degradation on this simulated frozen section masks atypia or involvement at 99%-scored inferior/lateral margins [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 11** — Highest tile risk (5%, <1%) and 99% inferior/lateral margin scores near the 100% threshold.
2. **Regions 7, 8, 9** — Confirm two-layered lobules directly; the `normal_lobules` concept is Unreliable (0/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 0, 3, 6** — Exclude stromal invasion (region 3), duct-confined atypia (region 6), and nuclear pleomorphism (region 0).
